recommendedConservativeEnrichment.approach: Keep the runtime result body unchanged and enrich metadata at the datastream and system levels.
reasons: One datastream already implies parameter family and unit.
Keeping the result body small reduces downstream contract churn.
Provenance fields can be documented without inflating every observation.

futureOptionalRuntimeExtensions.adoptionGuidance: Add only if a real consumer requires revision tracking or stronger upstream lineage at the observation level.
